subject: Economic buyer & budget owner follow-up - ACME Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (economic buyer & procurement)

Hi Sam — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Use case: ACME wants to accelerate in-product assistant responses for billing & support flows (short-form retrieval + generation).
- Scale: ~300K monthly active users, peak concurrency ~150 qps.
- Key criteria: latency <250ms p95, unit cost target, SOC2 + procurement approvals.
- Timeline: pilot in Jan, GA by end of Q1.

Actions we discussed:
1) Identify economic buyer / budget owner so we can align on commercial terms.
2) Intro to procurement for questionnaire & SOW review.
3) Security/compliance artifacts (SOC2 report, data handling controls). Dev is looped to cover the technical + security details.

Ask: Can you introduce me to the economic buyer (CFO or budget owner) and the procurement contact? If possible, please include any timeline or budget range they have in mind — that helps us prepare a concise proposal and SOW.

I attached a draft SOW and a revised pricing sheet for reference. Happy to set a 30-min procurement call next week — proposed slots: Wed 12/09 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 12/10 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, pricing-sheet-revised.pdf

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (economic buyer & procurement)

Thanks Marissa — great summary. I’ll loop in the right folks.

Introducing Priya Shah (Procurement) and Liam O'Neil (CFO) on this thread — Priya will run the questionnaire and handle contract review, Liam will sign off on budget. Our target is to finalize budget allocation by mid-Jan.

Priya / Liam — Marissa from Redwood ran us through the platform today. Two asks from our side up front:
- Can you share your typical procurement checklist and any mandatory contract terms?
- Ballpark budget range: we’re expecting ~$250–350k for the first year for the pilot + initial GA capacity, but that’s still to be confirmed with finance.

Priya, I have attached our procurement questionnaire template that we usually share with vendors — feel free to drop any deadlines.

Sam
VP Product | ACME Corp
sam.turner@acme.com

Hi Marissa — thanks for the SOW and pricing. A couple of items from procurement:

1) Please complete our attached questionnaire and return by EOD 12/10 so we can feed to InfoSec and Legal.
2) We’ll need to review SOC 2 Type II and any data residency commitments for PII.
3) Standard terms: our procurement team prefers limited liability and mutual indemnity; legal will send redlines after the questionnaire.

Can you confirm who on your side will handle the questionnaire? Also please propose two times for a 30-min procurement kickoff (Sam suggested Wed/Thu slots).

Thanks,
Priya Shah
